title: Aureline M5 correction-train archive
description: Canonical per-domain correction-train archive for the correction-train-archive object. Names the archived packet, its supported line association, the archived correction-train / hotfix-backport / advisory packet references, the exact build identity the archive packet is bound to, whether the packet has been archived, and its export class so correction history stays durable and inspectable and always joined to exact build/release-line identity rather than scattered internal notes. Downstream release, help, support, program-governance, and executive-steering surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's correction history by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
